title: Map Explorer
description: Place cards that pan the city map from one spot to the next as you swipe.
steps: `itemSize` is the screen width minus 72, so both neighbors peek in, scaled to 0.94 by `itemAnimation`.
The `progress` shared value pans the map on the UI thread, sliding from the current place toward the next one.
Pins grow up to 1.4× as `progress` nears them, and tapping a pin calls `scrollTo({ index })`.
